title: 第三章 活死人第四章 丹成杀机现
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
“你，许天。”
“还有你，李狗蛋。”
孙管事的目光落在两人身上，如看两个死人。
“你们两个废物，还没死呢？”
“真晦气，别TMD分拣了，把这垃圾拖到后山的耗材坑埋了！”
许天和李狗蛋心中一沉。
其他杂役则是投来幸灾乐祸的目光。
挖坑是个技术活，就算是两个壮汉都要花费好些功夫。
许天和李狗蛋两个弱不禁风的，恐怕要耽误一上午。
整整一上午，就是好几颗废丹！
再这样下去。
他们就是下一个二牛！
李狗蛋沉默不语，与许天一同脱着二牛尸体往外走。
后山。
所谓的耗材坑，其实就是个乱葬岗。
站在山顶往下眺望。
数不尽的坟堆。
两人走进一处山洞。
还未进去，就能嗅到洞内扑鼻恶臭。
“砰。”

将尸体放在一旁，他们拿起铲子，开始铲土。
一边铲，李狗蛋一边念叨：
“二牛兄弟，你安心上路，下辈子就无病无灾了。”
许天默默听着，没怎么接话。
李狗蛋。
他有印象。
好像与原主是一个村的。
不过仅此而已，这些日子两人并无过多交流。
“许……许哥……”
李狗蛋忽然停下铲子，压低声音：
“我们是一个村出来的，对吧？”
许天心中一凛，手中动作不停。
见他没反应，李狗继续说道：
“许哥，之前就听村里的老人们说过……说你家祖上，曾是这翻山宗的外门弟子！”
“是真正的仙师！”
许天依旧沉默，心中已是升起警惕。
见状，李狗声音又带上哭腔：
“许哥！你既然是仙师后人，肯定有你祖宗留下的宝贝或法子吧？”
“求求你，拉兄弟一把！”
“我，我昨天就差一颗废丹……被那些老杂碎抢走了……”

“许哥，那群带头的叫王霸，距离突破就差一点，最近在大肆搜刮废丹！”
自始至终，许天都没有答话。
他看得很清楚。
这根本不是拉同盟。
content_en:
"You, Xu Tian."
"And you, Li Goudan."
Manager Sun's eyes fell on the two of them, as if they were looking at two dead people.
"You two losers are not dead yet?"
"What a bad luck! Stop fucking sorting and drag this garbage to the consumables pit in the back mountain and bury it!"
Xu Tian and Li Goudan's hearts sank.
The other handymen looked at him with gloating eyes.
Digging a hole is a technical job, and even two strong men need to spend a lot of effort.
Xu Tian and Li Goudan are two very weak people, and I'm afraid it will take a whole morning.
There were several useless pills throughout the morning!
If this continues.
They are the next two bulls!
Li Goudan remained silent and walked out with Xu Tian, ​​taking off the corpses of the two cows.
Back mountain.
The so-called consumables pit is actually a mass grave.
Standing on the top of the mountain and looking down.
Countless graves.
The two walked into a cave.
Before entering, you can smell the pungent stench inside the cave.
"Bang."
Setting the body aside, they picked up shovels and began shoveling the soil.
While shoveling, Li Goudan muttered:
"Brother Erniu, you can go on your journey with peace of mind, and you will be free from illness and disaster in your next life."
Xu Tian listened silently and didn't answer much.
Li Goudan.
He was impressed.
It seems to be from the same village as the original owner.
But that's it, the two of them didn't communicate much these days.
"Xu...Brother Xu..."
Li Goudan suddenly stopped the shovel and lowered his voice:
"We come from the same village, right?"
Xu Tian felt a chill in his heart and kept moving his hands.
Seeing that he didn't respond, Li Gou continued:
"Brother Xu, I heard the elders in the village say before...that your ancestors were once outer disciples of Fanshan Sect!"
"He is a real immortal master!"
Xu Tian remained silent, his heart already rising with vigilance.
Seeing this, Li Gou's voice took on a crying tone again:
"Brother Xu! Since you are a descendant of the Immortal Master, you must have treasures or methods left by your ancestors, right?"
"Please, help my brother!"
"I, I was just short of a waste elixir yesterday... and it was taken away by those old bastards..."
"Brother Xu, the leader of that group is called Wang Ba. They are just a little short of a breakthrough. They have been searching for waste elixirs recently!"
From beginning to end, Xu Tian didn't answer.
He saw clearly.
This is not an alliance at all.
